ciFast.note: The implementation commit must pass Fast verification before merge.

ciDeep.note: The evidence replay is deterministic and keyless; no model call, adapter training, or device capture is required for this compiler and UX milestone.

deploy.note: Production proof will be sealed after the exact merged commit deploys and passes a cache-bypassed probe.

liveProvider.note: The compiler receipt replays already sealed evidence and the Scion chat path is verified with the browser-local runtime contract; no paid provider request is part of the claim.

manualHuman.note: This release makes no human, instructor, classroom, independent-review, or multi-judge claim.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: All 34 canonical gold courses, 4,477 unit tests, and 107 real-Chromium workspace and export tests passed locally. Live browser QA also verified one ZIP owner, high-contrast informational notes, Scion as the Agent model, and a shared progress value where 30% model transfer equals 5% overall with Map still pending. These gates prove compiler and browser regression safety, not factual correctness or model superiority.

claims.summary: The shared key-term contract rejects embedded labels, internal claim markers, copied cross-field content, and lesson facts mislabeled as misconceptions, while the public Scion route triggers bounded focused retry.

A keyless receipt binds both sealed judge orders and finds 19 double-observed Scion-base rejections, 14 newly caught cases, and zero paid-reference rejections across 82 source-bound key-term cases per model.
Scion model setup occupies the first 15 percent of one observable progress scale that the workspace continues through Map, Enrich, Compile, Verify, and Grade.
Downloadable advisory notes use a neutral blue information treatment and the export panel is the only Download ZIP owner.
